title: SD-card firmware updates for offline field devices

questions.prompt: Which option states the main idea of “SD-card firmware updates for offline field devices” correctly?
options: For safer ESP32 updates, flash can hold the running application and another app slot.
Where there is no internet, a technician can carry a firmware file on an SD card and update the device locally.
This example uploads from Arduino IDE to a supported ESP32 on the same Wi-Fi network.
OTA (Over-The-Air) updates a device over a network instead of plugging in a USB cable.
questions.answer: Where there is no internet, a technician can carry a firmware file on an SD card and update the device locally.
questions.explanation: Where there is no internet, a technician can carry a firmware file on an SD card and update the device locally.

questions.prompt: Which additional fact about “SD-card firmware updates for offline field devices” is accurate?
